installCommand: echo 'Flutter dependencies are installed in buildCommand.'
buildCommand: if [ ! -d .vercel/flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b stable .vercel/flutter; fi && .vercel/flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && .vercel/flutter/bin/flutter pub get && .vercel/flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --base-href=/ --no-wasm-dry-run --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=${API_BASE_URL:-}
